title: Peacock reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Peacock body -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='72' rx='14' ry='16' fill='#1a7cc4'/>
  <!-- Peacock belly lighter -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='76' rx='9' ry='10' fill='#5bb8f5'/>
  <!-- Neck -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='54' rx='6' ry='10' fill='#2a9de0'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='45' r='7' fill='#2a9de0'/>
  <!-- Crown feathers -->
  <line x1='41' y1='39' x2='38' y2='32' stroke='#2ed48a' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='31' r='1.8' fill='#7dffc4'/>
  <line x1='44' y1='38' x2='44' y2='30' stroke='#2ed48a' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='29' r='1.8' fill='#7dffc4'/>
  <line x1='47' y1='39' x2='50' y2='32' stroke='#2ed48a' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='31' r='1.8' fill='#7dffc4'/>
  <!-- Beak -->
  <polygon points='50,45 56,47 50,49' fill='#f5a623'/>
  <!-- Eye -->
  <circle cx='47' cy='44' r='1.8' fill='#fff'/>
  <circle cx='47.5' cy='44' r='0.9' fill='#1a1a4e'/>
  <!-- Tail feathers fanned out -->
  <g>
    <ellipse cx='18' cy='60' rx='5' ry='10' fill='#1e8e3e' transform='rotate(-30 18 60)'/>
    <ellipse cx='16' cy='68' rx='5' ry='10' fill='#27ae60' transform='rotate(-15 16 68)'/>
    <ellipse cx='17' cy='76' rx='5' ry='10' fill='#2ecc71' transform='rotate(5 17 76)'/>
    <ellipse cx='22' cy='82' rx='5' ry='10' fill='#27ae60' transform='rotate(25 22 82)'/>
    <!-- Eyespots on feathers -->
    <circle cx='16' cy='56' r='3' fill='#f5d76e'/>
    <circle cx='16' cy='56' r='1.5' fill='#1a7cc4'/>
    <circle cx='13' cy='67' r='3' fill='#f5d76e'/>
    <circle cx='13' cy='67' r='1.5' fill='#1a7cc4'/>
    <circle cx='15' cy='78' r='3' fill='#f5d76e'/>
    <circle cx='15' cy='78' r='1.5' fill='#1a7cc4'/>
    <circle cx='22' cy='86' r='3' fill='#f5d76e'/>
    <circle cx='22' cy='86' r='1.5' fill='#1a7cc4'/>
  </g>
  <!-- Book -->
  <g>
    <polygon points='30,68 52,66 52,82 30,84' fill='#e74c3c'/>
    <polygon points='52,66 74,68 74,84 52,82' fill='#c0392b'/>
    <!-- Pages -->
    <polygon points='32,70 51,68.5 51,80 32,81.5' fill='#fdf6e3'/>
    <polygon points='53,68.5 72,70 72,81.5 53,80' fill='#f5ecd7'/>
    <!-- Page lines -->
    <line x1='35' y1='72' x2='49' y2='71' stroke='#d4c9a8' stroke-width='0.8'/>
    <line x1='35' y1='75' x2='49' y2='74' stroke='#d4c9a8' stroke-width='0.8'/>
    <line x1='35' y1='78' x2='49' y2='77' stroke='#d4c9a8' stroke-width='0.8'/>
    <line x1='55' y1='71' x2='69' y2='72' stroke='#d4c9a8' stroke-width='0.8'/>
    <line x1='55' y1='74' x2='69' y2='75' stroke='#d4c9a8' stroke-width='0.8'/>
    <line x1='55' y1='77' x2='69' y2='78' stroke='#d4c9a8' stroke-width='0.8'/>
    <!-- Book spine -->
    <line x1='52' y1='66' x2='52' y2='82' stroke='#a93226' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  </g>
  <!-- Feet -->
  <line x1='35' y1='87' x2='30' y2='90' stroke='#f5a623' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='35' y1='87' x2='35' y2='91' stroke='#f5a623' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='35' y1='87' x2='40' y2='90' stroke='#f5a623' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='46' y1='87' x2='41' y2='90' stroke='#f5a623' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='46' y1='87' x2='46' y2='91' stroke='#f5a623' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='46' y1='87' x2='51' y2='90' stroke='#f5a623' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
